EMILY TRAINER’S INITIAL BRIEF
Emily Trainer, pro se intervenor, respectfully submits this Initial Brief. Emily Trainer’s intervenor item number is 29
Emily Trainer previously submitted testimony and exhibits that were admitted into the record. Intervenor respectfully requests that the Administrative Law Judges consider the admitted testimony and exhibits in their entirety. 
Based upon the evidence admitted into the record, Intervenor opposed the transmission line project in its entirety and respectfully recommends denial of the transmission line project. 
As set forth in Intervenor’s testimony and exhibits, the proposed project would negatively affect Intervenor’s family’s property, agricultural activities, income, future plans for the property, and continued use and enjoyment of the land. Those concerns are fully described in the evidence already admitted into the record.
In the alternative, should the project be approved, Intervenor continues to oppose Route A6 for the reasons set forth in the admitted testimony and exhibits. 
Respectfully Submitted,
/s/ Emily Trainer
Pro se Intervenor
